product: national operable merchantable-forest screening proxy v2
status: screening proxy; NOT a legal THLB, AAC landbase, or operability model; no slope screen because no national DEM is available

age.assumption: Stands below 20 or 30 years are treated as non-merchantable for the screen; this is stricter than the v1 height/biomass/closure thresholds and is a screening convention, not a legal rule.

disturbance.assumption: A 30 m pixel is burned when its centre falls inside a 2020 NBAC fire polygon. NBAC 2020 is an annual fire layer, not a cumulative severity stack.

road.method: Road segments rasterised at 990 m with all-touched; Euclidean distance transform gives nearest-public-road distance at block centres.
road.caveat: Public NRN roads only; resource, industrial, winter, and decommissioned roads are absent.

slope.detail: No national DEM in the workspace; no slope filter applied.

age_ge_20.label: base and SCANFI median age >= 20 years

age_ge_30.label: base and SCANFI median age >= 30 years

road_le_5km.label: base within 5 km of an NRN road

road_le_10km.label: base within 10 km of an NRN road

road_le_20km.label: base within 20 km of an NRN road

screen_core20.label: age >= 20, not NBAC 2020 burned, within 20 km of road

screen_core30.label: age >= 30, not NBAC 2020 burned, within 10 km of road

disturbance.note: Only the 2020 annual NBAC vintage is present. The 2010 and 2015 disturbance sensitivity cases are gaps, not zero-disturbance cases.

intensity_150m.interpretation: 150,000,000 m3/yr is an upper scenario bound, not a forecast or an AAC. Intensity is target volume divided by the screened operable area. It is not a growth/yield estimate and does not demonstrate sustainability.

gaps.detail: No legal timber harvesting landbase boundary is used. Tenure is a rights footprint, not a harvest-landbase determination.
gaps.effect: All areas are screening proxies and must not be labelled THLB or AAC.

gaps.detail: No national DEM is present in the workspace, so no slope, elevation, operability, or site-degradation filter is applied.
gaps.effect: Steep and inoperable terrain remains in every v2 area.

gaps.detail: The NBAC bundle is the 2020 annual vintage (YEAR=2020 for all 710 polygons). It contains no 2010 or 2015 fire history, so those sensitivity screens cannot be computed from this input.
gaps.effect: Only a 2020 fire screen is reported; the 2010 and 2015 cases are explicit gaps, not zero-disturbance assumptions.

gaps.detail: NBAC polygons are annual fire perimeters with YEAR/NFIREID and polygon attributes. They are not a cumulative severity or burn-class stack, so no cumulative class is interpreted.
gaps.effect: The disturbance screen is an annual 2020 burned/not-burned mask.

gaps.detail: All 13 NRN province bundles were materialised and used. NRN is the public road network; resource, industrial, winter, and decommissioned roads are not represented, and road condition/seasonality is absent.
gaps.effect: Road distance is an optimistic public-road access proxy.

gaps.detail: SCANFI median age is a stand-age prediction. Excluding stands below 20 or 30 years assumes they are not merchantable at the screen date, which is stricter than the v1 height/biomass/closure thresholds and ignores partial harvest, thinning, and regeneration delay.
gaps.effect: Age screens reduce area beyond merchantability alone.

gaps.detail: The v1 managed share is uniform inside each province-ecoprovince. Tenure was not re-intersected with the age, burn, or road rasters.
gaps.effect: Spatial tenure pattern is not represented.

gaps.detail: SCANFI age is a 30 m prediction surface, not a provincial inventory or a time-since-disturbance record.
gaps.effect: Age thresholds are screening conventions, not statutory rules.

caveats: Screening proxy only; not a legal THLB, AAC landbase, or harvest feasibility test.
No slope, elevation, or operability screen: no national DEM is available.
NBAC 2020 is an annual fire vintage; 2010 and 2015 disturbance cases are gaps.
NRN is the public road network; resource and industrial roads are absent.
Managed share is uniform inside each province-ecoprovince; tenure is not intersected spatially.
SCANFI age is a prediction surface, not a census or disturbance record.
NU and PE managed and operable values remain blank because the 2016 tenure compilation has no coverage.
